Thanks for the ping — dug into the promotions -> grants pipeline. Summary and actions: 

Root cause:
- The promotions service normalizes some coupon slugs to uppercase and strips leading/trailing whitespace. The webhook filter that routes to the grants worker was expecting the original slug exactly (case-sensitive). RW-WELCOME-100 matched the promotion, but the webhook filter used a different canonicalization, so the grant creation job was dropped quietly (no retry).

What I did:
1) Performed a manual grant from the admin console for novaforge-prod: 1000 credits (trial) — issuance id: grant-admin-20261129-41. Link: https://console.redwood.ai/grants/grant_20261129_41
2) Pushed an immediate fix on the filter normalization (hotfix) which ensures we compare normalized coupon slugs.
3) Triggered a backfill for missing grants for signups since 2026-11-26; output shows Novaforge was included.

Visible confirmation:
- Admin grant receipt attached (admin_grant_receipt.pdf). Elena should see the credits once they refresh or sign-in again. If they still don't, clearing cache and verifying Billing > Credits should help.

Next steps for ops: Marissa / Priyom, please update the promo bookkeeping doc with the incident note and attach the HubSpot ticket (https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/ticket/67890). I'll follow up with an ops postmortem tomorrow.

Ben Carter
